scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: (test ! -f server/package.json || npm run build --prefix server) && (test ! -f client/package.json || npm run build --prefix client)
scripts.lint: (test ! -f server/package.json || npm run lint --prefix server) && (test ! -f client/package.json || npm run lint --prefix client)
scripts.typecheck: (test ! -f server/package.json || npm run typecheck --prefix server) && (test ! -f client/package.json || npm run typecheck --prefix client)
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: (test ! -f server/package.json || npm run test:unit --prefix server) && (test ! -f client/package.json || npm run test:unit --prefix client)
scripts.test:integration: test ! -f server/package.json || npm run test:integration --prefix server
scripts.test:e2e: test ! -f client/package.json || npm run test:e2e --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && (test ! -f server/package.json || npm install --prefix server) && (test ! -f client/package.json || npm install --prefix client)
